Navigating growth amid macro headwinds including tariffs and West Asia conflict.

Telluric Foods (India) Limited, the immediate wholly owned subsidiary, had nil turnover at 31 March 2026 and 31 March 2025, and ₹18.48 lakh at 31 March 2024.
Successfully commenced operations at the Surat greenfield facility in Q4FY26.
Annual food processing capacity across facilities stands at ~38,000 MT.
Ashoka brand recorded ₹308 Cr revenue in FY26.
Surat greenfield facility Phase 1 began operations in third week of March 2026; Phase 2 line expected in Q3FY27.
GCC region accounts for slightly under 15% of ADF Foods' overall revenue.
Surat facility commenced commercial deliveries in Q1FY27 with initial container shipments
Truly Indian brand expanded from 2,000 to 3,000 stores in US with 60% growth from existing stores
Received AEO-T3 certification from CBIC for improved export efficiency

timeline.summary: ADF Foods Limited announces Q4 & FY 2025-26 earnings conference call on May 14, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST with Bimal Thakkar, Sumer Thakkar, and Srinivas Ayyagari.
ADF Foods reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹196.73 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹0.60 per share.
ADF Foods Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.60 per share (30%) on equity shares, subject to 36th AGM approval on August 12, 2026.

ADF Foods' board approved up to ₹10 Cr of investment in OCRPS of wholly owned subsidiary Telluric Foods (India) Limited, to be down-streamed to step-down arm Telluric Foods Limited for brand building and working capital in FY27.
ADF Foods approved an additional equity investment of AUD 100,000 in its Australian wholly owned subsidiary on May 13, 2026.
On May 13, 2026, ADF Foods reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹196.7 Cr (+23.7% YoY) and recommended a final dividend of 30%.
ADF Foods released its Q4 & FY26 corporate presentation detailing a target to reach ₹1,000+ Cr revenue in FY27.
ADF Foods held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding to ₹925–1,000 Cr revenue in FY27 subject to West Asia stability.
ADF Foods Q1FY27 results: Revenue up 25.9% YoY to ₹167.3 Cr, EBITDA margin 17.7%; Surat facility commences commercial deliveries; maintains FY27 guidance of ₹900 Cr+
Board of Directors will consider declaration of interim dividend on equity shares for FY 2026-27 at meeting on 5 November 2026.
An earnings conference call for Q2 & H1 FY 2026-27 will be held on Friday, 6th November 2026 at 03:30 PM (IST).
